conventions: TypeScript strict mode throughout; no `any` in public types, no non-null assertions on values that can be missing at runtime.
Prettier formatting (repo config: double quotes, trailing commas, 2-space indent); ESLint runs with --max-warnings=0, so import order and unused imports matter.

Import order: external packages first, then `@excalidraw/*` package aliases (`@excalidraw/common`, `@excalidraw/element`, `@excalidraw/math`), then relative imports; type-only imports use `import type`.
Inside packages/excalidraw import other workspace packages by alias (`@excalidraw/element`, `@excalidraw/common`), never by relative path into another package's src.
Data is immutable: build new arrays/objects (spread, map, filter); mutate elements only through `mutateElement`/`newElementWith`, except where a unit rule explicitly allows a direct field assignment.
Prefer `?.` and `??`; keep hot paths (render, hit-test, scene getters) allocation-free where an existing cache can be reused.
AGENTS.md: use `app.ownerDocument` / `app.ownerWindow` instead of `document` / `window` in editor code; prefer `Merge<>` from `@excalidraw/common/utility-types` over `Omit<> &`.
React function components with hooks; class names are kebab-case BEM-like under `.excalidraw` (e.g. `page-tab-bar__tab`); styles in a sibling `.scss` file imported by the component.
i18n: every user-visible string goes through `t("key")` from `../i18n` style imports; new keys are added only to `packages/excalidraw/locales/en.json`, never to other locale files.

Actions are created with `register({...})` from `actions/register`, given an `ActionName` added to `actions/types.ts`, exported from `actions/index.ts`, and return `{ elements?, appState?, captureUpdate }` or `false`.

Tests use Vitest (`describe`/`it`/`expect`) with jsdom; editor tests render `<Excalidraw />` via `render` from `tests/test-utils` and drive it with `API`, `Keyboard`, `Pointer`, `UI` from `tests/helpers`; never hand-edit `__snapshots__` (they are regenerated with `yarn test:update`).
Accessibility: interactive tab-bar controls are `<button type="button">` elements with an `aria-label` or visible text; tabs use `role="tab"` inside a `role="tablist"` and expose `aria-selected`.
Never use bare `git stash`; rollback is by commits.

decisions.choice: Every element carries an optional `pageId?: string` field (on `_ExcalidrawElementBase`); there is one Scene holding all pages, and its existing getters return only the active page's elements while new `getAllPages*` getters return every page.
rejected: Separate element arrays per page (one Scene per page or a `pages[].elements` container)
decisions.reason: One flat array keeps element versioning, getSceneVersion, reconcileElements, Firebase, localStorage and Store/History deltas unchanged, and legacy files migrate by stamping the default page id.

decisions.choice: Scene keeps the active page's elements in its existing fields and every other page's elements in a separate map; `replaceAllElements(next)` replaces the active page's elements and upserts (never removes) elements of other pages; `replaceAllElements(next, { allPages: true })` replaces every page, and App passes it whenever an action result or updateScene payload carries `elements` together with an `appState.pages` whose reference differs from `this.state.pages` (a whole-drawing load or a page deletion; ordinary actions spread appState and keep the same reference) and from resetScene; a Scene whose active page is null (temporary scenes in delta/transform, tests) behaves exactly as today; `setActivePage(pageId)` re-partitions; an element whose `pageId` is missing is stamped with the active page id by direct assignment; paste and library insert set `pageId` to the active page explicitly on the elements they create.
rejected: A global filtered view rebuilt on every getter call
Full replacement of all pages on every replaceAllElements
decisions.reason: Every existing caller (render, hit-test, selection, frames, binding, export, actions) becomes page-scoped with no call-site change, cost scales with the active page (NFR-2), and internal code that rebuilds the active list can never drop another page.

decisions.choice: Fractional indices are independent per page: `syncInvalidIndices`, `syncInvalidIndicesImmutable` and `validateFractionalIndices` partition their input by `pageId` and validate/sync each page's subsequence separately.
rejected: One global index order across pages
decisions.reason: A global order would force index rewrites (and version bumps broadcast to collaborators) on every page switch or cross-page reconcile.

decisions.topic: Page model and where it lives
decisions.choice: The types `ExcalidrawPage = { id, name, index, version, versionNonce, isDeleted }` (index is a fractional-index string for order) and `PageViewport = { scrollX: number, scrollY: number, zoom: number }` (zoom is the plain zoom value) live in `packages/element/src/types.ts` and the helpers in `packages/element/src/pages.ts`; AppState gains `pages: readonly ExcalidrawPage[]` (deleted pages kept as tombstones), `activePageId: string` and `pageViewports: Readonly<Record<string, PageViewport>>`.
rejected: Viewport stored on the page object
decisions.reason: Versioned tombstoned pages reconcile deterministically in collaboration; keeping viewports in a separate key makes them local-only (FR-20) while still saved to file and localStorage.

decisions.choice: `DEFAULT_PAGE_ID = "page-1"` and `DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME = "Page 1"` constants in pages.ts; `getDefaultAppState` holds exactly that one page; new pages are named `t("pages.newPageName", { number })` where number starts at the visible page count + 1 and increments while a visible page already has that name.
rejected: A random id for the default page
decisions.reason: A fixed id makes legacy migration and independently started collab clients converge on the same default page.

decisions.choice: `pages`, `activePageId` and `pageViewports`: browser true, export true, server false.
decisions.reason: All three persist in files and localStorage; the `server` flag only governs share links and Excalidraw+ export, which carry the active page's elements only (FR-11), while collaboration and the Firebase room carry pages in their own encrypted fields.

decisions.choice: One History; each recorded entry is tagged with the active page id at record time; undo/redo pop the most recent entry tagged with the current active page and leave other pages' entries in place; page keys are not observed by AppStateDelta, so page switches and viewport changes record nothing; page create/rename/reorder/delete use `CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER` and are not undoable.
decisions.reason: Pages own disjoint element sets, so skipping other pages' entries never conflicts, and undo on page A can never mutate page B (FR-10).

decisions.choice: The Store commits the all-pages elements map (`scene.getAllPagesElementsMapIncludingDeleted()`) and History applies deltas to it, so a page switch is never seen as element removal.
decisions.reason: Diffing only the active page would record a switch as deleting the previous page's elements.

decisions.choice: Switching goes through `actionSwitchPage` (value: page id); its pure helper `getSwitchPageAppState(appState, pageId)` saves the current viewport into `pageViewports`, loads the target viewport (default scroll 0/0, zoom 1), and clears selection, editing group, editing text, linear editing and in-progress elements; App calls `scene.setActivePage` before applying elements whenever an action result or updateScene changes `activePageId`; `ExcalidrawImperativeAPI.setActivePage(pageId)` executes the same action.
decisions.reason: One code path for tab bar, API, search and collab, and the scene is re-partitioned before the next render so no frame shows the old page.

decisions.choice: A `PageTabBar` component rendered by the editor Footer; hidden in zen mode; in view mode it shows tabs for switching only (no add, rename, move or delete controls).

Reorder with move-left/move-right buttons for the active tab (actionMovePage, value `{ pageId, direction: -1 | 1 }`); delete via a button for the active tab, disabled when one visible page remains, with a `ConfirmDialog` when the page has non-deleted elements; delete marks the page tombstoned, marks its elements `isDeleted`, and switches to the next visible page (else the previous).
decisions.reason: Buttons are keyboard-accessible and deterministic to test in jsdom; FR-7 allows move actions.

decisions.choice: `VERSIONS.excalidraw` stays 2; the new fields (`appState.pages`, `appState.activePageId`, `appState.pageViewports`, element `pageId`) are optional and additive.
decisions.reason: Gate 1 decision 4; older readers ignore unknown keys and show all elements on one canvas, and the new reader repairs missing data, so no bump is required.

decisions.choice: `restoreAppState` takes the three page keys like every other key (supplied value, else localAppState value, else default) and then normalizes them: pages via `restorePages` (drop invalid entries, keep the first of duplicate ids, empty or missing list yields the default page), `activePageId` falling back to the first visible page, and `pageViewports` keeping only valid entries of existing pages; `loadSceneOrLibraryFromBlob` passes the file's restored `pages` and `activePageId` explicitly so a legacy file never inherits the local pages; every whole-scene load (`loadSceneOrLibraryFromBlob` and App's scene replacement in initialData/updateScene/resetScene paths) then calls `repairElementPages` so an element with a missing or unknown `pageId` moves to the active page and cross-page bindings, bound text and frame membership are cut; `restoreElements` only preserves a string `pageId`.
decisions.reason: Deterministic repair for legacy and corrupt data (FR-12, AC-10).

decisions.choice: `onChange` elements and `getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted()` return every page's elements; `getSceneElements()` returns the active page's non-deleted elements; `updateScene({ elements })` uses the Scene upsert semantics (other pages' elements are kept unless passed).
decisions.reason: Hosts persisting or syncing from onChange keep all pages, while hosts that add elements to the visible canvas keep working unchanged.

decisions.choice: SCENE_INIT and SCENE_UPDATE payloads gain an optional encrypted `pages` array; Collab broadcasts when the pages version (sum of page versions) changes, merges remote pages with `reconcilePages` (higher version wins, equal versions keep the lower versionNonce), and switches locally to the first visible page if its active page became deleted; mouse-location payloads carry `pageId` and collaborator pointers on another page are not rendered.
decisions.reason: Reuses the existing encrypted broadcast path (NFR-7) and keeps each user's active page local (FR-20).

decisions.choice: `FirebaseStoredScene` gains optional `pagesCiphertext` and `pagesIv` fields holding the encrypted JSON page list; rooms without them load onto the default page.
rejected: Changing the encrypted elements payload into an object
decisions.reason: Old clients keep reading the elements ciphertext unchanged, and legacy rooms load without data loss.

units.behaviour: Pure helpers for the page model: defaults, ordering, create/rename/move/delete, restore, reconcile and element-page repair.
rules: Imports: `generateKeyBetween` from `@excalidraw/fractional-indexing`; `randomId`, `randomInteger`, `arrayToMap` from `@excalidraw/common`; `isBoundToContainer`, `isBindingElement`, `isFrameLikeElement` from `./typeChecks`; types from `./types`. Every function is pure and never mutates its arguments.

`DEFAULT_PAGE_ID = "page-1"`, `DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME = "Page 1"`; `getDefaultPage()` returns `{ id: DEFAULT_PAGE_ID, name: DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME, index: "a0", version: 1, versionNonce: 0, isDeleted: false }` (deterministic so independent clients converge).
`getVisiblePages(pages)` returns the non-deleted pages sorted by `index` ascending, ties broken by `id` ascending.
`getActivePage(pages, activePageId)` returns the visible page with that id, else the first visible page, else null.
`getPageElements(elements, pageId)` returns the elements whose `pageId` equals `pageId`, in input order.
`getNewPageName(pages, formatName)` calls `formatName(n)` starting at n = visible page count + 1 and increments n while a visible page already has that exact name.

`createPage(pages, name, id?)` appends `{ id: id ?? randomId(), name, index: generateKeyBetween(lastVisible?.index ?? null, null), version: 1, versionNonce: randomInteger(), isDeleted: false }` and returns `{ pages: [...pages, page], page }`.
A page update (rename, move, delete) returns a new page object with `version + 1` and a new `randomInteger()` versionNonce, and a new array with that page replaced in place.
`renamePage(pages, pageId, name)` trims the name; when the trimmed name is empty, the page is missing or deleted, or the name is unchanged, it returns the same `pages` reference.

`movePage(pages, pageId, direction)` works on `getVisiblePages`: when the page is first and direction is -1, or last and direction is 1, it returns the same reference; otherwise the page's new index is `generateKeyBetween` of the two neighbours around its target slot (null at either end).
`deletePage(pages, pageId)` returns the same reference when the page is missing, already deleted, or the only visible page; otherwise it tombstones the page (`isDeleted: true`).
`getAdjacentPageId(pages, pageId)` returns the id of the visible page after `pageId`, else the one before, else null (computed on the visible order before any deletion).
`getPagesVersion(pages)` returns the sum of page versions.

`restorePages(pages: unknown)` keeps only array entries that are objects with a non-empty string `id`; keeps the first entry of each duplicate id; defaults `name` to `Page N` (N = 1-based position) when not a non-empty string, `index` via `generateKeyBetween(previousIndex, null)` when not a string, `version` to 1 and `versionNonce` to 0 when not finite numbers, `isDeleted` to `entry.isDeleted === true`; when no visible page remains it appends `getDefaultPage()` (with a fresh index after the last one when the default id is already taken, replacing the tombstone with the same id instead); the result is sorted by index then id.
`restoreActivePageId(pages, activePageId: unknown)` returns `activePageId` when it is a string id of a visible page, else the first visible page's id.

`reconcilePages(localPages, remotePages)` unions by id; for an id on both sides, the higher version wins and equal versions keep the one with the lower versionNonce; the result is sorted by index then id.

`repairElementPages(elements, pages, activePageId)` returns a new array: an element whose `pageId` is not a string or names no page in `pages` (tombstones count as existing) becomes `{ ...element, pageId: activePageId }`; then, using a map of the resulting elements, a bound text element (`isBoundToContainer`) takes its container's `pageId`, an element whose `frameId` refers to an element on another page gets `frameId: null`, a binding element whose `startBinding`/`endBinding` refers to an element on another page gets that binding set to null, and `boundElements` entries referring to elements on another page are removed; elements needing no change are returned as the same object; no version is bumped.

units.behaviour: Scopes the Scene's existing element getters to the active page while keeping every other page's elements, and adds page switching and all-pages getters.
rules: New private fields: `activePageId: string | null = null`, `otherPagesElements: Map<string, OrderedExcalidrawElement>` (element id to element, elements of every page except the active one), and lazily built caches `allPagesElements: readonly OrderedExcalidrawElement[] | null` and `allPagesElementsMap: SceneElementsMap | null`, reset to null by every replaceAllElements and setActivePage.
While `activePageId` is null the Scene behaves exactly as today: nothing is stamped, `otherPagesElements` stays empty and the all-pages getters return the same array/map as the active ones.

`replaceAllElements(next, options?: { skipValidation?: true; allPages?: true })`: first stamp every element whose `pageId` is undefined with `activePageId` by direct assignment through `Mutable<ExcalidrawElement>` (no version bump); with `allPages` clear `otherPagesElements` first; then elements whose `pageId` differs from `activePageId` are set into `otherPagesElements` (an upsert; existing other-page elements not passed are kept), and an id that now belongs to the active page is deleted from `otherPagesElements`; the remaining active-page elements, in input order, go through the existing validation, `syncInvalidIndices` and map/frame/non-deleted rebuild; with `allPages`, also run `syncInvalidIndices` over the other-page elements; finally `triggerUpdate()`.

`setActivePage(pageId)` is a no-op when `pageId === activePageId`; otherwise it takes `getAllPagesElementsIncludingDeleted()`, sets `activePageId`, stamps undefined `pageId`s with the new id, rebuilds `otherPagesElements` from elements of other pages, orders the new page's elements with `orderByFractionalIndex` on a copy, clears the selection cache and calls `replaceAllElements` with them (with skipValidation).

`getAllPagesElementsIncludingDeleted()` returns the other pages' elements in `otherPagesElements` insertion order followed by the active page's elements; `getAllPagesElementsMapIncludingDeleted()` returns a `SceneElementsMap` of the same elements; both are cached until the next change.
`getActivePageId()` returns `activePageId`.
`destroy()` also clears `otherPagesElements`, resets both caches to null and sets `activePageId` to null.

units.behaviour: Registers the create, switch, rename, move and delete page actions and the pure page-switch app-state helper.
rules: `getSwitchPageAppState(appState, pageId)` returns null when `pageId === appState.activePageId` or no visible page has that id; otherwise it returns a Partial<AppState> with `activePageId: pageId`; `pageViewports` = previous map without `pageId`, plus the current page's `{ scrollX, scrollY, zoom: zoom.value }`; `scrollX`/`scrollY`/`zoom` from the target's saved viewport (zoom via `{ value: getNormalizedZoom(v.zoom) }`), else `0`, `0`, `{ value: 1 as NormalizedZoomValue }`; and resets `selectedElementIds: {}`, `selectedGroupIds: {}`, `previousSelectedElementIds: {}`, `hoveredElementIds: {}`, `editingGroupId: null`, `editingTextElement: null`, `selectedLinearElement: null`, `newElement: null`, `multiElement: null`, `resizingElement: null`, `selectionElement: null`, `activeEmbeddable: null`, `isCropping: false`, `croppingElementId: null`, `editingFrame: null`, `frameToHighlight: null`, `elementsToHighlight: null`; `searchMatches` is left unchanged (the renderer skips match ids that are not on the active page).

`actionSwitchPage` (name `switchPage`, `viewMode: true`, label `pages.switchTo`, trackEvent `{ category: "canvas" }`): `perform(_elements, appState, pageId: string)` returns false when `getSwitchPageAppState` is null, else `{ appState: { ...appState, ...switchState }, captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER }`.

`actionCreatePage` (name `createPage`, label `pages.newPage`, `viewMode: false`, trackEvent canvas): `perform(_elements, appState)` creates a page named `getNewPageName(appState.pages, (n) => t("pages.newPageName", { number: n }))` with `createPage`, then applies `getSwitchPageAppState` on `{ ...appState, pages }` to the new id; returns `{ appState: { ...appState, ...switchState, pages }, captureUpdate: NEVER }`.

`actionRenamePage` (name `renamePage`, label `pages.rename`, `viewMode: false`): value `{ pageId: string; name: string }`; returns false when `renamePage` returns the same reference, else `{ appState: { ...appState, pages }, captureUpdate: NEVER }`.

`actionMovePage` (name `movePage`, label `pages.moveLeft`, `viewMode: false`): value `{ pageId: string; direction: -1 | 1 }`; returns false when `movePage` returns the same reference, else `{ appState: { ...appState, pages }, captureUpdate: NEVER }`.

`actionDeletePage` (name `deletePage`, label `pages.delete`, `viewMode: false`): value `pageId: string`; computes `adjacentId = getAdjacentPageId(appState.pages, pageId)` first, then `pages = deletePage(...)`; returns false when the reference is unchanged; marks every non-deleted element of that page from `app.scene.getAllPagesElementsIncludingDeleted()` with `newElementWith(el, { isDeleted: true })`; when the deleted page is active, applies `getSwitchPageAppState({ ...appState, pages }, adjacentId)`; returns `{ elements: <all pages' elements with the deleted ones replaced>, appState: { ...appState, ...switchState, pages }, captureUpdate: NEVER }` (a new `pages` reference, so App replaces every page).
None of the actions has a keyTest; all are registered via `register` so `actions/register` picks them up when imported.

units.behaviour: Wires the Scene's active page and the page-scoped History into the editor, and exposes `setActivePage` and all-pages element data to hosts.
rules: A private method `applySceneElements(elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[], nextAppState: Partial<AppState> | null | undefined)` does: `const nextPages = nextAppState?.pages; const nextActive = nextAppState?.activePageId ?? this.state.activePageId; const allPages = !!nextPages && nextPages !== this.state.pages;` when `allPages`, call `this.scene.setActivePage(nextActive)` first and then `this.scene.replaceAllElements(repairElementPages(elements, nextPages, nextActive), { allPages: true })`; otherwise call `this.scene.setActivePage(nextActive)` and `this.scene.replaceAllElements(elements)`; in both cases call `this.history.notifyActivePageChanged()` when the scene's active page id changed.

A private method `syncActivePage(nextAppState: Partial<AppState> | null | undefined)` calls `this.scene.setActivePage(nextAppState.activePageId)` and `this.history.notifyActivePageChanged()` when `nextAppState?.activePageId` is defined and differs from `this.scene.getActivePageId()`.

In the constructor, right after `this.scene = new Scene();`, call `this.scene.setActivePage(this.state.activePageId)`; both `new History(this.store)` calls become `new History(this.store, () => this.scene.getActivePageId())`.

In `syncActionResult`, `actionResult.elements` are applied with `this.applySceneElements(actionResult.elements, actionResult.appState)`; when there are no elements, `this.syncActivePage(actionResult.appState)` runs before the setState.
In `updateScene`, the scene update moves before `setState`: `if (elements) this.applySceneElements(elements, appState) else this.syncActivePage(appState)`; then `if (appState) this.setState(...)`.
In `resetScene`, `this.scene.replaceAllElements([])` becomes `this.scene.setActivePage(DEFAULT_PAGE_ID)` followed by `this.scene.replaceAllElements([], { allPages: true })`.

In `addElementsFromPasteOrLibrary`, before `this.scene.replaceAllElements(nextElements)`, set `pageId` of every element in `duplicatedElements` to `this.state.activePageId` by direct assignment through `Mutable<ExcalidrawElement>` (they are new, unversioned-in-scene copies).

`getSceneElementsIncludingDeleted` returns `this.scene.getAllPagesElementsIncludingDeleted()` and `getSceneElementsMapIncludingDeleted` returns `this.scene.getAllPagesElementsMapIncludingDeleted()`; `getSceneElements` is unchanged (active page, non-deleted).

A new public `setActivePage = (pageId: string) => { this.actionManager.executeAction(actionSwitchPage, "api", pageId); }` is added after `getSceneElements`, and `setActivePage: this.setActivePage` is added to the object built in `createExcalidrawAPI` after `updateScene`.

In componentDidUpdate, `this.store.commit(elementsMap, this.state)` commits `this.scene.getAllPagesElementsMapIncludingDeleted()`, and `onChange` / `onChangeEmitter.trigger` receive `this.scene.getAllPagesElementsIncludingDeleted()` instead of `elements` (the local `elements` stays the active page for the checks above).
Imports: `DEFAULT_PAGE_ID` and `repairElementPages` are added to the `@excalidraw/element` import ending at line 210; `actionSwitchPage` is added to the `../actions` import list.
